note: Campground run by the Fox Lake Conservation League on the southeast corner of Fox Lake near Sherburn; one open loop of sites along the shore road, with docks and boat access. --Claude
summary: League page: 30 electric sites, $25 (undated), first come first served, open May 1 - Sep 30, caretaker phone 517-247-8857. Season/booking/count confirmed (now manual). Amps, showers, water fill and dump (stored, note prose) not on the page. Pin is in a marsh ~220 m east of the loop: move. Not waterfront looks too low: lakeview recommended.
flags: PIN: stored 43.67620,-94.66600 is in a cattail marsh east of the campground. The camping loop is centred ~43.6761,-94.6687 on imagery (~220 m W). Recommend moving the pin there.

WATERFRONT: recommend not waterfront -> lakeview. On imagery the single camping loop sits on the Fox Lake shore; its north road runs 10-20 m from the water with docks off it, and the sites inside the loop are about 25-60 m from the lake behind that road and a thin, gappy line of trees. The loop road rules out lakefront. No site numbers can be placed (the league posts no site map), so the reviewer may prefer to keep it as stored.

Ownership: stored local, and the old note called it 'a Martin County park'; Martin County's parks page does not list Everett Park (its county parks are Perch Lake, Cedar/Hanson, Bright Lake, Timberlane, Klessig and Wolter). The league's own page names no public owner. Who owns the land was not established; reviewer may consider private (a conservation club) if no public owner turns up.
Stored hookups electric 30 (amps), facilities showers / potable water / dump (note prose, derived) are NOT on the league's page, which says only '30 electrical campsites'. Left alone; unconfirmed.
Phone: stored 517-247-8857 is the caretaker number printed on the league page (a Michigan area code, but it is the number posted). OK.
